about: CI-2 review gallery: one genuine CI-1 selection per approved cut-in category. Each record is the reveal snapshot of a real simulated round (tools/cutins-lab/rates.ts runTournament, career careerFor(tour, 1000 + season), full mode), at the round's last boundary. tests/cutins.present.test.ts re-simulates every record and checks it byte for byte.
